youtube_title: When people lie about you | Psalm 7
youtube_description:
What do you do when someone is telling lies about you? Psalm 7 is David's answer: run to God, and leave your case with the righteous judge.

In verse 9, God "tests the minds and hearts." The Hebrew literally says hearts and kidneys: kelayot (klah-YOTE), seen in Hebrew as the seat of the deepest feelings. God sees all the way down. And the one who digs a pit falls into it himself (Psalm 7:15-16).

Today's step: don't dig a pit of your own. Bring your case to God, and let him judge.

Day 7 of the Psalms, one chapter a day. Follow @thebibleexplainedai so you don't miss Psalm 8.

Read it: Psalm 7:1-17
